definition: a person who is deeply loved
description: Inside an airport terminal at night during a snowstorm. A tearful young woman in a camel coat jumps into the arms of a young man in a snow-covered green parka and knit hat, who holds a bunch of red roses behind her back, and they hug tightly, laughing. Around them stranded travellers sit on the floor wrapped in sleeping bags and silver foil blankets, clapping and smiling. A suitcase stands nearby, and through the tall glass windows a snowplough with orange lights works in the falling snow.

en.question: What is the man in green holding?

de.answer: Er hält einen Strauß roter Rosen.
